Data:Ability.json.label: Element of the Soul
Data:Ability.json.desc: The human soul is composed of nine elements, and this is one. Most other things have simpler souls. [Each Soul card can be used once a day, for the kind of things you do with your soul. That usually means 'talking to people' or 'crafting'.]

Data:Ability.setup.json.label: Element of the Soul?
Data:Ability.setup.json.desc: The human soul is composed of nine elements... [Remember what you were, with the help of your journal.]

Data:Acquaintance.denzil.json.label: A Firelit Doorway
Data:Acquaintance.denzil.json.startdescription: A mutual acquaintance will introduce me to Denzil the Smith. I might get six or even ten words out of him if I'm patient.
Data:Acquaintance.denzil.json.desc: Denzil is a surprising source of practical advice. [The Smithy is now available.]

Data:Acquaintance.killes.json.label: Cradles and Coffins
Data:Acquaintance.killes.json.startdescription: A mutual acquaintance has induced the Killes to invite me for a fish supper.  If I'm lucky, 'fish supper' may mean Mrs Kille's celebrated galettes.
Data:Acquaintance.killes.json.desc: Mr Kille pumps my hand. 'Just me and thee and the Mrs tonight! Eh, well, there's a client in the back, but if thee don't bother he, he won't bother thee.'[The Killes household is now available.]

Data:Acquaintance.rectory.json.label: Tea with the Rector
Data:Acquaintance.rectory.json.startdescription: A mutual acquaintance has induced Reverend Timothy, the Rector, to invite me for tea. There may even be crumpets.
Data:Acquaintance.rectory.json.desc: Reverend Timothy's tea goes cold while he expostulates about post-Restoration politics, and theorises about the pagan traditions of the miners. [The Rectory is now available.]

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.buy.json.label: A Wary Welcome at the Inn
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.buy.json.startdescription: In the time of the Heptarchy, a ring-giver was accounted generous. In this bright and civilised century, a beer-buyer enjoys the same regard.
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.buy.json.desc: I bought a round for everyone. And another. And one more for luck. And thus was I accounted 'not so bad for a foreigner'. I'll find a warmer welcome here next time.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.chor.json.label: Just Keep Smiling
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.chor.json.startdescription: I've learnt that honest enthusiasm is a solvent for surliness.
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.chor.json.desc: Eventually the other patrons unbend enough to let me buy them a pint, and let me listen to them complain about the weather. I'll find a warmer welcome here next time.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.introductio.label: Introductions
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.introductio.startdescription: I haven't come alone. @#assistance.rector|Reverend Timothy's presence demands respect.#assistance.coffinmaker|Mr Kille repeats a long string of well-worn jokes that leaves everyone groaning happily.#assistance.midwife|Mrs Kille asks one surly youth about his mother's health, and clouts another round the back of the head when she suspects him of looking at me funny. #assistance.blacksmith|Denzil doesn't say a word. He sits with his arms folded and waits until others come to pay their respects to him at our table. #|My companion makes introductions.@
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.introductio.desc: Eventually, the other patrons unbend enough to let me buy them a pint, and let me listen to them complain about the weather. I'll find a warmer welcome here next time.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.mettle.json.label: Force of Personality
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.mettle.json.startdescription: I'm not going away. They don't have to like me.
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.mettle.json.desc: Eventually the other patrons unbend enough sufficiently to let me buy them a pint, and let me listen to them complain about the weather. I'll find a warmer welcome here next time.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.notyet.abil.label: No Room at the Inn?
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.notyet.abil.startdescription: The Sweet Bones is barred and shuttered against the storm... and against unwelcome visitors. There must be somewhere in the village that will give me shelter.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.notyet.mone.label: No Room at the Inn?
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.notyet.mone.startdescription: The Sweet Bones is barred and shuttered against the storm... and against unwelcome visitors. There must be somewhere in the village that will give me shelter.

Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.shapt.json.label: A Silver Tongue
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.shapt.json.startdescription: A tough audience. I've charmed tougher.
Data:Acquaintance.sweetbones.shapt.json.desc: Eventually the other patrons unbend enough to let me buy them a pint, and let me listen to them complain about the weather. I'll find a warmer welcome here next time.

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.coffinmaker..label: Shelter?
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.coffinmaker..startdescription: Mr Kille struggles with the door. The wind almost snatches it from his hands. [The storm-wind plucks at you both.]

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.coffinmaker..label: Shelter!
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.coffinmaker..startdescription: Mr Kille struggles with the door. The wind almost snatches it from his hands. His eyes widen as he sees me.
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.coffinmaker..desc: Mr Kille is grinning like the happiest of skulls. 'Come in, come in! Less 'ee wants fitted for a box?' And he leads me into the warmth of the parlour, calling for Mrs Kille to come see, come see the rescue.

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.denzil.start.label: A Firelit Doorway?
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.denzil.start.startdescription: Denzil looms in the fire-bright doorway. [The storm-wind plucks at you both.]

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.denzil.start.label: A Firelit Doorway
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.denzil.start.startdescription: Denzil looms in the fire-bright doorway. 'You? Here? How?'
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.denzil.start.desc: I stagger into the smithy, out of the cold at last. Without another word, Denzil hands me a blanket and sets about stoking the fire: the warmest welcome of which he is capable.

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.midwife.hint.label: Shelter?
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.midwife.hint.startdescription: Mrs Kille struggles with the door. The wind almost snatches it from her hands. [The storm-wind plucks at you both.]

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.midwife.json.label: Shelter!
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.midwife.json.startdescription: Mrs Kille opens the door with caution, but flings it wide, letting the wind bang it, when she sees me.
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.midwife.json.desc: 'Mrs Kille drags me into her broad embrace, releases me when she realises how damp I am, and then she's calling for Mr Kille and dragging me into the warmth of the parlour. 'Sit 'ee down and get a drop of warm in!', she enjoins sternly.

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.rectory.hint.label: A Clergyman Distrait?
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.rectory.hint.startdescription: The door opens a few cautious inches. 'Who's there? I say, who's there?  [The storm-wind plucks at you, plucks at the door, shakes the trees around the house...]

Data:Act1start.acquaintance.rectory.json.label: A Clergyman Distrait
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.rectory.json.startdescription: The Reverend staggers back as if he'd received a blow, and then he's bombarding me with terrified, delighted questions before I'm even through the door.
Data:Act1start.acquaintance.rectory.json.desc: Timothy ushers me into the bright hall, casting about for his housekeeper, and asking questions the whole time. 'How did you come here? Was it the wreck? Terrence! Terrence, do fetch towels!'

Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrkille.json.label: Take Shelter with the Killes
Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrkille.json.startdescription: Mr Kille constructed the bed himself - I rather fear with the same tools he uses to shape coffins. It is not a comfortable bed. But it's dry, clean, and warm.
Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrkille.json.desc: I sit up talking with Mr and Mrs K, as the wind rattles the shutters and the fire shrugs its way emberward. I'm very hungry, and Mrs K's galettes are impossibly good. Mr K pretends to grumble about foreign cooking. No-one is convinced.

Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrskille.json.label: Take Shelter with the Killes
Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrskille.json.startdescription: Mr K constructed the bed himself - I rather fear with the same tools he uses to shape coffins. It is not a comfortable bed. But it's dry, clean, and warm.
Data:Act1start.dry.health.mrskille.json.desc: Mrs K and I sit up late talking over old times in the Latin Quarter, when the world and we were very different. Mr K listens as he cleans his pipe. 'Wine and roses,' he observes. 'Spose the wine is all spilt now, but the roses'll come up again, won't them?'

Data:Act1start.dry.health.rectory.json.label: Take Shelter at the Rectory
Data:Act1start.dry.health.rectory.json.startdescription: Reverend Timothy flutters fussily while Terrence the Housekeeper busies herself with practicalities. She shows me to a warm room at the top of the house where a fire is already made up.
Data:Act1start.dry.health.rectory.json.desc: Reverend Timothy is touchingly excited to meet his correspondent in person. I am still too exhausted to hold up my end of the conversation, and Terrence is not a talkative woman, but the Reverend can talk for three. At last however he suddenly realises how exhausted I am, and lets me sleep.

Data:Act1start.dry.health.smithy.json.label: Take Shelter at the Smithy
Data:Act1start.dry.health.smithy.json.startdescription: Denzil only has the one bed, but he can offer me a straw mattress in the smithy. It's smoky, but the warmth is very welcome.
Data:Act1start.dry.health.smithy.json.desc: Denzil pauses at the door as I wish him goodnight. 'Sun'll be back,' he observes. 'Always do. Used to say that in the War, dint we?' The words linger as he clumps up the passage. The lamp-flame flickers red, gold, red.

Data:Acted.agdistis.curse.heart.json.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.curse.heart.json.desc: Mr Agdistis resolved to do his best to help a friend who'd purchased cursed items.

Data:Acted.agdistis.observe.scaly.sky.js.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.observe.scaly.sky.js.desc: Mr Agdistis decided to ignore the summoning to go West, electing to reject the possibility of transformation, and remain what he was.

Data:Acted.agdistis.opera.apollo.sky.jso.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.opera.apollo.sky.jso.desc: Mr Agdistis helped arrange the score for 'Apollo and Marsyas.'

Data:Acted.agdistis.pan.heart.json.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.pan.heart.json.desc: Mr Agdistis resolved to experiment with honey.

Data:Acted.agdistis.project.ingenious.sk.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.project.ingenious.sk.desc: Mr Agdistis wrote a memorial piece for Zuthimalim Zidane.

Data:Acted.agdistis.wound.heart.json.label: Acted: Agdistis
Data:Acted.agdistis.wound.heart.json.desc: Mr Agdistis learnt that the 'Open Reverend' was not connected with the power Agdistis serves.
